summary: Mild-to-clear frustration: UI didn't refresh after action
detailed_context: Nick ran Force Renew on Christine's member page in the AccessBuddy admin, and the page did not update on its own. He had to leave and reopen it to see the result. The fix was presented as ready to use, so this is a real gap in the post-action experience, not a cosmetic issue. His message is short and carries no profanity, but 'This is not ideal' signals clear dissatisfaction with the outcome. The lesson is that after a mutating admin action, the page should refetch or invalidate its data so the new state shows immediately. The assistant should also verify this behaviour in the UI before telling Nick a flow is ready, not only confirm the deploy succeeded.
